queries.label: schemas
queries.statement: SELECT schema_name FROM workspace.information_schema.schemata WHERE schema_name IN ('airbnb_bronze','airbnb_silver','airbnb_gold')

queries.label: bronze
queries.statement: SELECT _city city, count(*) n, count(DISTINCT id) unique_ids FROM workspace.airbnb_bronze.listings WHERE _city IN ('milan','florence') AND _snapshot_date = DATE '2026-09-19' GROUP BY _city

queries.label: silver
queries.statement: SELECT city city, count(*) n, count(DISTINCT listing_id) unique_ids FROM workspace.airbnb_silver.listings WHERE city IN ('milan','florence') AND snapshot_date = DATE '2026-09-19' GROUP BY city

queries.label: features
queries.statement: SELECT city city, count(*) n, count(DISTINCT listing_id) unique_ids FROM workspace.airbnb_gold.model_features WHERE city IN ('milan','florence') AND snapshot_date = DATE '2026-09-19' GROUP BY city

queries.label: city_metrics
queries.statement: SELECT city, sum(listings) n, sum(priced_listings) priced FROM workspace.airbnb_gold.city_metrics WHERE city IN ('milan','florence') AND snapshot_date = DATE '2026-09-19' GROUP BY city

queries.label: room_type_metrics
queries.statement: SELECT city, sum(listings) n, sum(priced_listings) priced FROM workspace.airbnb_gold.room_type_metrics WHERE city IN ('milan','florence') AND snapshot_date = DATE '2026-09-19' GROUP BY city

queries.label: neighbourhood_metrics
queries.statement: SELECT city, sum(listings) n, sum(priced_listings) priced FROM workspace.airbnb_gold.neighbourhood_metrics WHERE city IN ('milan','florence') AND snapshot_date = DATE '2026-09-19' GROUP BY city

queries.label: features_vs_silver
queries.statement:
SELECT count(*) differences FROM workspace.airbnb_gold.model_features f
            FULL OUTER JOIN workspace.airbnb_silver.listings s USING (city,snapshot_date,listing_id)
            WHERE coalesce(f.city,s.city) IN ('milan','florence') AND coalesce(f.snapshot_date,s.snapshot_date) = DATE '2026-09-19'
            AND (f.listing_id IS NULL OR s.listing_id IS NULL OR NOT (f.price_eur <=> s.price_eur) OR NOT (f.eligible_for_training <=> s.eligible_for_training))

queries.label: ingestion_manifest
queries.statement: SELECT city,row_count,source_url FROM workspace.airbnb_bronze.ingestion_manifest WHERE city IN ('milan','florence') AND snapshot_date = DATE '2026-09-19'

queries.label: pipeline_validations
queries.statement: SELECT * FROM workspace.airbnb_gold.pipeline_validations WHERE city IN ('milan','florence') AND snapshot_date = DATE '2026-09-19'

queries.label: split_fingerprint
queries.statement: SELECT count(*) n, sha2(concat_ws('\n', array_sort(collect_list(concat_ws('|',city,cast(snapshot_date AS string),cast(listing_id AS string),coalesce(evaluation_split,''))))),256) fingerprint FROM workspace.airbnb_gold.model_split WHERE city IN ('milan','florence') AND snapshot_date = DATE '2026-09-19' AND split_salt='airbnb-v1'

queries.label: baseline_fingerprint
queries.statement: SELECT count(*) n, sha2(concat_ws('\n', array_sort(collect_list(concat_ws('|',baseline_level,coalesce(room_type,''),coalesce(cast(cast(accommodates AS bigint) AS string),''),cast(cast(round(median_price_eur*1000000) AS bigint) AS string),cast(n_train AS string))))),256) fingerprint FROM workspace.airbnb_gold.baseline_lookup WHERE baseline_version='airbnb-v1'

queries.label: prediction_coverage
queries.statement: SELECT count(*) n, count(DISTINCT struct(city,snapshot_date,listing_id,model_version)) unique_keys, count_if(baseline_prediction_eur IS NULL) baseline_null FROM workspace.airbnb_gold.predictions WHERE city IN ('milan','florence') AND snapshot_date = DATE '2026-09-19' AND model_version='price-v1'

queries.label: prediction_keys_vs_features
queries.statement: SELECT count(*) differences FROM workspace.airbnb_gold.model_features f FULL OUTER JOIN (SELECT * FROM workspace.airbnb_gold.predictions WHERE model_version='price-v1') p USING(city,snapshot_date,listing_id) WHERE coalesce(f.city,p.city) IN ('milan','florence') AND coalesce(f.snapshot_date,p.snapshot_date)=DATE '2026-09-19' AND (f.listing_id IS NULL OR p.listing_id IS NULL OR NOT(f.price_eur <=> p.actual_price_eur))

queries.label: official_test_mae
queries.statement: SELECT CASE WHEN grouping(city)=1 THEN 'milan+florence' ELSE city END city_group, count(*) n, avg(abs(model_prediction_eur-actual_price_eur)) model_mae_eur, avg(abs(baseline_prediction_eur-actual_price_eur)) baseline_mae_eur, count_if(model_prediction_eur IS NULL OR baseline_prediction_eur IS NULL OR actual_price_eur IS NULL) invalid FROM workspace.airbnb_gold.predictions WHERE city IN ('milan','florence') AND snapshot_date = DATE '2026-09-19' AND model_version='price-v1' AND evaluation_split='test' GROUP BY GROUPING SETS ((city),())

queries.label: model_evaluation
queries.statement: SELECT city_group,n,model_mae_eur,baseline_mae_eur FROM workspace.airbnb_gold.model_evaluation WHERE model_version = 'price-v1' AND evaluation_population = 'test_all_valid_positive_price'

queries.label: model_selection_hash
queries.statement: SELECT sha2(record_json,256) computed_sha256,record_sha256,spec_sha256 FROM workspace.airbnb_gold.model_selection WHERE model_version='price-v1'

settings.description: One city/snapshot per run: bronze → silver → gold → validation. Run Milan and Florence sequentially before the Week 1 freeze.
settings.name: airbnb-cities-etl
